data.long_meaning: One who is free, independent. The name Carl carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carl total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
